Main agent should confirm the preview ingress/deployment for the frontend is healthy before user validation — this is likely an emergent platform routing issue, not app code.

HINTS array is duplicated with backend seed data; drift-prone. Consider a small /api/demo-accounts endpoint or shared manifest.
